context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Replace the wildcard `app.use(cors())`, which allows every origin, with an explicit allowlist: `const allowedOrigins = ['https://your-trusted-app.example']; app.use(cors({ origin: (origin, cb) => cb(null, !origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)), credentials: true }));`. Use `credentials: true` only with the listed origins. Also serve every route that carries Personal Data over HTTPS only: redirect HTTP to HTTPS and enable HSTS. Set session cookies with `secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'strict'` (or `'lax'` if cross-site navigation is needed) in the session or cookie options.
